title: Particle burst
description: A pop that punctuates a beat: an optional word or badge scales in with overshoot, ripple rings spread, and seeded particles (dots, confetti squares, streaks or sparkle lines) burst out and fall away. Transparent, to drop on a cut or a click.

label.description: A short word or emoji in a pill that pops in at the centre (empty: none).

shape.description: Particle shape: dots, confetti squares, motion streaks, sparkle lines (a ring of short rays), or a mix.

origin.description: Where it bursts, {x, y} from 0 to 1.

colors.description: Particle colours as #rrggbb (empty: accent, secondary and ink).

rings.description: Ripple rings spreading from the origin.

gravity.description: How fast particles fall, px/s² at 1080.
